customer_id.meaning: primary id of the person's Cartwise profile; every customer and every shopper has exactly one

name.meaning: full name on the profile, as the person gave it

phone_number.meaning: mobile number registered on the profile

email.meaning: email address registered on the profile

date_of_birth.meaning: date of birth on the profile

zip_code.meaning: ZIP code of the profile's home address

home_state.meaning: state of the profile's home address

verification_id.meaning: primary id of the identity-verification record (one per customer)

verified.meaning: whether verification passed; never goes back from true to false

verified_at.format: ISO timestamp YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS, as returned by ctx.now()
verified_at.meaning: moment of the most recent verification attempt

handoff_id.meaning: primary id of the human-handoff record

reason.meaning: reason for the handoff; closed set of exactly these two values

created_at.format: ISO timestamp YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS, as returned by ctx.now()

membership_id.meaning: primary id of the Cartwise+ membership

variant_name.meaning: Cartwise+ plan held, as the official plan name

trial_end_date.meaning: last day of the free trial; empty when no trial was granted

eligibility_verified_date.meaning: date the plan's required proof (SNAP/EBT card or student email) was accepted; empty when none required or not yet accepted

current_period_start.meaning: first day of the current paid period

current_period_end.meaning: renewal date that ends the current paid period (the next period starts on this date)

auto_renew.meaning: whether the membership renews at current_period_end

past_due_since.meaning: date the unpaid period fee was first declined; empty unless past_due

pause_start_date.meaning: first paused day; empty unless a pause is booked or running

pause_end_date.meaning: last paused day; empty unless a pause is booked or running

plan_switched_date.meaning: date the most recent plan switch took effect; empty when never switched

canceled_date.meaning: date the membership ended; empty while not canceled

cancel_reason.meaning: why the membership ended; empty while not canceled

credit_balance_usd.meaning: current Cartwise+ credit balance; identical to the sum of the plus_credit account's deltas

priority_upgrades_remaining.meaning: Priority Delivery upgrades left in the current period; identical to the sum of the priority_upgrades account's deltas

membership_event_id.meaning: primary id of the membership ledger row

membership_id.meaning: membership the row belongs to (foreign key -> memberships)

event_type.meaning: event family of the row, as declared in the membership charter

fee_type.meaning: why a period fee was charged; empty on other rows

refund_type.meaning: basis of a fee refund; empty on other rows

amount_usd.meaning: money amount of the row, always positive; the event_type gives the direction

quantity.meaning: number of Priority Delivery upgrades allotted or used; empty on money rows

billing_period_start.meaning: first day of the period a fee or allotment belongs to

order_id.meaning: order the credit or upgrade row concerns (foreign key -> orders); empty otherwise

source_event_id.meaning: membership_events row this row refunds or expires (the original fee charge or credit earning); empty otherwise

member_customer_id.meaning: household member added or removed (foreign key -> customers); empty otherwise

membership_request_id.meaning: primary id of a customer's membership request awaiting confirmation

membership_id.meaning: membership the request concerns (foreign key -> memberships)

requested_variant_name.meaning: target plan for a switch_plan request; empty otherwise

request_status.meaning: where the request stands; it takes effect only once confirmed by the customer

created_at.format: ISO timestamp YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS, as returned by ctx.now()

order_id.meaning: primary id of the grocery order

variant_name.meaning: service level of the order, as the official name

retailer_name.meaning: store the order is shopped at, exactly as listed in the app

scheduled_window_start.format: ISO timestamp YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS, as returned by ctx.now()
scheduled_window_start.meaning: start of the booked delivery or pickup window (after any reschedule)

scheduled_window_end.format: ISO timestamp YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS, as returned by ctx.now()
scheduled_window_end.meaning: end of the booked delivery or pickup window (after any reschedule)

membership_id.meaning: Cartwise+ membership whose benefits were judged at checkout (foreign key -> memberships); empty for non-members

batch_id.meaning: shopper batch that holds the order (foreign key -> batches); empty before shopping

completed_at.format: ISO timestamp YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS, as returned by ctx.now()
completed_at.meaning: exact handoff time; empty until completed

returned_date.meaning: date the order was returned to the store; empty otherwise

cancel_stage.meaning: whether shopping had started when the cancellation was confirmed; empty otherwise

closed_date.meaning: date the order closed; empty until closed

tip_usd.meaning: current tip on the order; identical to the sum of the tip account's deltas

order_event_id.meaning: primary id of the order ledger row

order_id.meaning: order the row belongs to (foreign key -> orders)

event_type.meaning: event family of the row, as declared in the order charter

line_number.meaning: position of the item line on the order (1, 2, 3 ...); together with order_id it identifies one line; empty on fee and tip rows

item_name.meaning: product as listed on the order line

item_category.meaning: item class: weighted items are sold by weight and count as perishable; heavy items drive heavy fees and heavy pay; alcohol drives ID checks and exclusions

requested_quantity.format: decimal: units, or pounds for weighted items
requested_quantity.meaning: quantity the customer asked for on the line

quantity.format: decimal: units, or pounds for weighted items
quantity.meaning: quantity billed or refunded on the line

original_unit_price_usd.meaning: unit price of the product originally ordered

unit_price_usd.meaning: unit price actually billed (the replacement's price when substituted)

line_outcome.meaning: how the billed line relates to what was ordered

substitute_item_name.meaning: replacement product handed over; empty unless substituted

substitution_decision.meaning: how an out-of-stock line was settled

fee_type.meaning: which fee a fee row concerns; empty otherwise

waiver_basis.meaning: membership benefit behind a fee waiver; empty otherwise

refund_reason.meaning: controlled reason of an item or fee refund; empty otherwise

refund_destination.meaning: where a refund is paid; empty otherwise

source_event_id.meaning: order_events row a refund pays back (the original item or fee charge); empty otherwise

batch_id.meaning: shopper batch a tip row is for (foreign key -> batches); empty otherwise

amount_usd.meaning: money amount of the row, always positive; the event_type gives the direction

order_review_request_id.meaning: primary id of a refund request sent to the review team

requested_amount_usd.meaning: amount sent for review (the part not booked by the agent)

created_at.format: ISO timestamp YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS, as returned by ctx.now()

shopper_account_id.meaning: primary id of the shopper contractor account

customer_id.meaning: profile of the person holding the account (foreign key -> customers)

variant_name.meaning: shopper level, as the official level name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the contractor account

background_check_date.meaning: date the most recent background check was ordered

license_expiry_date.meaning: expiry date of the driver licence on file; empty for Shop-Only

insurance_expiry_date.meaning: expiry date of the vehicle insurance on file; empty for Shop-Only

rating_warning_date.meaning: date the open rating warning was issued; empty when none is open

level_evaluated_date.meaning: date of the most recent level change

hold_start_date.meaning: first day of the current hold; empty unless on_hold

hold_reason.meaning: why the current hold was placed; empty unless on_hold

deactivated_date.meaning: date of the most recent deactivation; empty when never deactivated

deactivation_reason.meaning: cause of the most recent deactivation

reactivated_date.meaning: date of the most recent reactivation; empty when never reactivated

closed_date.meaning: closure date; empty while not closed

closure_reason.meaning: why the account closed; empty while not closed

violation_points_balance.meaning: active violation points; identical to the sum of the violation_points account's deltas

shopper_event_id.meaning: primary id of the shopper ledger row

shopper_account_id.meaning: contractor account the row belongs to (foreign key -> shopper_accounts)

event_type.meaning: event family of the row, as declared in the shopper charter

order_id.meaning: order the rating or violation concerns (foreign key -> orders); empty when none

batch_id.meaning: batch the rating or violation concerns (foreign key -> batches); empty when none

rating.meaning: stars given by the customer; empty on other rows

violation_type.meaning: controlled violation; the last six are zero-tolerance

points.meaning: violation points added or removed, always positive; the event_type gives the direction

exclusion_reason.meaning: why a rating was excluded; empty otherwise

removal_reason.meaning: why a violation was cleared; empty otherwise

source_event_id.meaning: shopper_events row this row excludes or clears (the rating or violation); empty otherwise

event_date.meaning: date the row was booked (rating date, violation date, clearing date)

shopper_appeal_id.meaning: primary id of an appeal or dispute submitted by the shopper

source_event_id.meaning: violation row disputed (foreign key -> shopper_events); empty for deactivation appeals

appeal_status.meaning: decision on the appeal; submitted until decided

created_at.format: ISO timestamp YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS, as returned by ctx.now()

batch_id.meaning: primary id of the shopper batch

customer_id.meaning: profile of the shopper who accepted the batch (foreign key -> customers)

shopper_account_id.meaning: contractor account that accepted the batch (foreign key -> shopper_accounts)

variant_name.meaning: batch type, as the official name

store_name.meaning: store the batch is shopped at, exactly as listed in the app

accepted_at.format: ISO timestamp YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS, as returned by ctx.now()

shopping_started_at.format: ISO timestamp YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS, as returned by ctx.now()

item_count.meaning: item units in the batch (units already shopped, for a batch canceled mid-shop)

estimated_miles.meaning: estimated route miles shown on the offer; the basis of mileage pay

actual_miles.meaning: GPS miles driven; used only for mileage disputes

wait_minutes.meaning: waiting minutes recorded in the app at the store counter and doors

shown_pay_usd.meaning: pay before tips shown on the accepted offer

drop_reason.meaning: why the batch was dropped; empty otherwise

cancel_stage.meaning: whether shopping had started when the batch was canceled; empty otherwise

finalized_date.meaning: date pay became final; empty until finalized

earnings_usd.meaning: earnings on the batch including tips; identical to the sum of the batch_earnings account's deltas

batch_event_id.meaning: primary id of the batch earnings row

batch_id.meaning: batch the row belongs to (foreign key -> batches)

event_type.meaning: event family of the row, as declared in the batch charter

pay_component.meaning: which pay component a pay row posts; empty otherwise

order_id.meaning: order a per-order component or tip belongs to (foreign key -> orders); empty for batch-level components

adjustment_reason.meaning: reason of an approved pay adjustment; empty otherwise

batch_pay_dispute_id.meaning: dispute an adjustment answers (foreign key -> batch_pay_disputes); empty otherwise

reversal_reason.meaning: ground of a pay reversal; empty otherwise

source_event_id.meaning: batch_events pay row a reversal takes back; empty otherwise

amount_usd.meaning: money amount of the row, always positive; the event_type gives the direction

batch_pay_dispute_id.meaning: primary id of a pay dispute submitted by the shopper

dispute_reason.meaning: what the shopper says is missing

claimed_amount_usd.meaning: amount the shopper says is owed, as stated

created_at.format: ISO timestamp YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS, as returned by ctx.now()

payout_account_id.meaning: primary id of the shopper payout account

shopper_account_id.meaning: contractor account paid out (foreign key -> shopper_accounts)

variant_name.meaning: payout plan, as the official plan name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the payout account

verified_date.meaning: date the destination was verified; empty until verified

destination_last4.meaning: last four digits of the bank account or card receiving payouts

destination_changed_at.format: ISO timestamp YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS, as returned by ctx.now()
destination_changed_at.meaning: moment the destination was last replaced; empty when never replaced

plan_changed_date.meaning: date of the most recent plan change; empty when never changed

frozen_date.meaning: date of the current freeze; empty unless frozen

freeze_reason.meaning: cause of the current freeze; empty unless frozen

closure_reason.meaning: why the account closed; empty while open

available_balance_usd.meaning: earnings not yet paid out, negative when debits exceeded credits; identical to the sum of the earnings_balance account's deltas

cashback_balance_usd.meaning: card cashback earned and not yet paid; identical to the sum of the cashback account's deltas

payout_event_id.meaning: primary id of the payout ledger row

payout_account_id.meaning: payout account the row belongs to (foreign key -> payout_accounts)

event_type.meaning: event family of the row, as declared in the payout charter

batch_id.meaning: batch whose earnings row is credited or debited (foreign key -> batches); empty otherwise

batch_event_id.meaning: batch earnings row credited or debited (foreign key -> batch_events); empty otherwise

source_event_id.meaning: payout_events row this row relates to (the cashout a fee belongs to, the transfer returned, the fee refunded); empty otherwise

cashout_number.meaning: sequence of an instant cashout within its calendar day (1, 2, ...); empty otherwise

payout_period_end.meaning: last day of the weekly earnings period a deposit sweeps; empty otherwise

statement_month.meaning: statement month a cashback row belongs to; empty otherwise

merchant_category.meaning: merchant category of a cashback earning; empty otherwise

refund_reason.meaning: why a cashout fee was refunded; empty otherwise

amount_usd.meaning: money amount of the row, always positive; the event_type gives the direction

payout_request_id.meaning: primary id of a shopper's payout request awaiting confirmation

requested_variant_name.meaning: target plan of a change_plan request; empty otherwise

request_status.meaning: where the request stands; it takes effect only once confirmed by the shopper

created_at.format: ISO timestamp YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS, as returned by ctx.now()

giftcard_id.meaning: primary id of the gift card

customer_id.meaning: profile the card belongs to (purchaser until registered, then the registering holder) (foreign key -> customers)

variant_name.meaning: card type, as the official name

card_last4.meaning: last four digits of the gift card number

activated_date.meaning: date the activation hold cleared; empty before

expiry_date.meaning: date expiring value lapses; empty when nothing expires

registered_date.meaning: date the holder registered the card; empty when unregistered

suspended_date.meaning: date of the current suspension; empty unless suspended

suspend_reason.meaning: why the card is suspended; empty unless suspended

depleted_date.meaning: date the balance reached zero; empty unless depleted

close_reason.meaning: why the card closed; empty while open

balance_usd.meaning: value remaining on the card; identical to the sum of the card_balance account's deltas

giftcard_event_id.meaning: primary id of the gift card ledger row

giftcard_id.meaning: card the row belongs to (foreign key -> giftcards)

event_type.meaning: event family of the row, as declared in the gift card charter

order_id.meaning: order paid or refunded (foreign key -> orders); empty otherwise

source_event_id.meaning: order_events refund row returned to the card; empty otherwise

transfer_reason.meaning: why a balance moved between cards; empty otherwise

counterpart_giftcard_id.meaning: other card of a balance transfer (foreign key -> giftcards); empty otherwise

removal_reason.meaning: why value left the card; empty otherwise

amount_usd.meaning: money amount of the row, always positive; the event_type gives the direction

rewards_account_id.meaning: primary id of the Cartwise Rewards account

variant_name.meaning: rewards tier, as the official tier name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the rewards account

activated_date.meaning: date the first qualifying order closed; empty before

tier_evaluated_date.meaning: date of the most recent tier change

suspended_date.meaning: date of the current suspension; empty unless suspended

close_reason.meaning: why the account closed; empty while open

points_balance.meaning: points available; identical to the sum of the points account's deltas

rewards_event_id.meaning: primary id of the rewards ledger row

rewards_account_id.meaning: rewards account the row belongs to (foreign key -> rewards_accounts)

event_type.meaning: event family of the row, as declared in the rewards charter

order_id.meaning: order the row concerns (foreign key -> orders); empty otherwise

source_event_id.meaning: row this row restores or reverses (a redemption row, or an order_events refund row); empty otherwise

points.meaning: points moved, always positive; the event_type gives the direction

amount_usd.meaning: dollar value applied by a redemption; empty otherwise
